The deployment's `node --test` suite (55 tests) passes on the patched files. The chart theme (T-6886): `render.js` draws every Vega-Lite spec in `theme.js` (new: `self.jcTheme = ` and `crates/shared/jc-chart/src/theme.json`, held equal by the module test `the_theme_script_is_the_theme_file`), light or dark by the `theme` member of the host's message, under the spec's own `config`; `host.js` passes that member on and takes the scheme itself (`host.css`, `render.css` dark rules), and `render.html` loads `theme.js`. Back to the deployment: `components/viz` takes the same `jc.patch` hunks and a copy of `theme.json` as `theme.js` (no such task filed; the vendored copy is the one served). Re-take with the same archive and `patch -p0 < jc.patch` inside `vendor/viz` (the patch names `site/<file>`; it is a diff of the archive's `site/` against this one, `/dev/null` for an added file), then rewrite `SHA256SUMS`. |
